summary.text: Dave Shallenberger is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 58, in office since 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as a small business owner with a mechanical engineering degree from Brigham Young University and a law degree from Willamette University.

paragraphs.text: David Shallenberger earned a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from Brigham Young University and a J.D. from Willamette University.
His career experience includes working as a small business owner.
He took office in the Utah House in 2025, succeeding Keven Stratton.
